secretsResidual.managedRotationDescription: Creates a new provider-backed version. Consumers pinned to latest pick up the new value on the next run.
secretsResidual.referenceRotationDescription: Creates a new Paperclip metadata version that points at an existing provider secret. Paperclip does not write a new provider value.
secretsResidual.valueRotationDescription: Writes a new version of the referenced provider secret. The new value becomes current for every consumer of that secret, in and outside Paperclip.
